summary: Verified NEW referral counter feature end-to-end. Backend GET /api/feed returns referral_count=3 for demo-00 alongside 12 Tokyo feed items. Frontend chip data-testid='bottom-nav-referral-count' renders '· 3 joined' on Feed, Matches, and Profile bottom nav share pill. Share click triggers clipboard fallback with '?ref=yui.tokyo' attribution URL and shows success toast. All 6 review checkpoints pass.

fragment_signin_lands_on_feed.details: Loading /#st=sttest_SUQD-bH3lyJJOBLw-llOftxhxupA_9nU landed on data-testid='feed-screen' (demo-00 now has agreed_to_rules_at seeded).

backend_feed_referral_count.details: GET /api/feed with Bearer returns keys ['feed','city_stats','saved_position','referral_count']; referral_count=3; feed length=12 (Tokyo demo users).

chip_on_feed.details: data-testid='bottom-nav-referral-count' visible inside 'bottom-nav-share' pill, text='· 3 joined'.

chip_on_matches.details: After tapping nav-matches, chip text='· 3 joined' rendered.

chip_on_profile.details: After tapping nav-profile, chip text='· 3 joined' rendered.

share_link_attribution.details: Clicking bottom-nav-share on headless Chromium fell back to clipboard. Clipboard content = 'Come meet the world at Nice2Meechu 👋 https://hyperlocal-video.preview.emergentagent.com/?ref=yui.tokyo'. Sonner toast 'Invite link copied — friends who join count as yours!' rendered.

zero_state_conditional.details: Code inspection BottomNav.js:86 — chip is wrapped in `referralCount > 0 && (...)` so users with 0/absent referral_count render only 'Share this app' text. Backend also always returns referral_count (0 default) so frontend never sees undefined.

regression_feed_and_no_console_errors.details: Feed rendered videos (24 <video> elements = 12 items × 2 tracks). No JS runtime errors on Feed/Matches/Profile. Console 'errors' observed are 404s for /favicon and static assets (pre-existing, unrelated to this feature).

critical_code_review_comments: BottomNav.js:14 — fallback URL when userHandle is missing points to 'https://nice2meechu.com' (no ref param). Consider still appending window.location.origin so preview/staging invites work without a handle; low priority.
BottomNav.js:86 — good use of `referralCount > 0` guard; chip won't render for zero state. Verified.
seed_data_creation: None (demo-00 already seeded with agreed_to_rules_at per prior iteration action item)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Referral counter feature complete and working. Feed API returns referral_count. BottomNav chip renders on all 3 tabs when >0, hidden when 0. Share pill copies link with ?ref=<handle> and shows toast. No regressions.
